description: This source file implements functions and classes for incremental lookup in a fixed set data structure, specifically for string matching and retrieval within a DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). It includes methods for advancing through the automaton based on input characters, extracting result values, and performing suffix-based lookups in a reversed set.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: A class for performing incremental lookups in a fixed set graph, supporting character-by-character traversal and result extraction.

methods.name: GetNextOffset
methods.description: Reads the next offset from the current position in the graph, updating position and offset pointers accordingly.

methods.name: IsEOL
methods.description: Checks if the byte at the given offset indicates the end of a label.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the byte at the given offset matches a specified key.

methods.name: GetReturnValue
methods.description: Extracts a return value from the given offset if it encodes one.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the lookup position based on an input character, updating internal state.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the result value associated with the current position in the graph.
